description: Two distinct flagged occurrences over one projected span each contribute weight (engine §7.10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | d | c
%rule (leftmost-longest) w (X [+T]) | ([+U] X)
%rule missing (M N)
%rule (leftmost-longest) d (X T)
%rule (leftmost-longest) c (inner T)
%rule (leftmost-longest) inner X
